mistake_reason: The orchestrator explicitly instructed avoiding extrapolation and not conflating cross-list counts with ps availability (Step 21). In direct contradiction, WebSurfer then used the January 2020 cross-list number (43) from the year stats page as the count of ps versions (Step 22), abandoning the agreed plan of verifying ps endpoints for each article. This reasoning-action mismatch (FM-2.6) led to the wrong final answer.
